messages:
alice_support: anyone seeing a spike of 502s to hosted-api from the edge? multiple customer tickets came in after the 09:30 deploy, started ~09:40 UTC :thinking:

jess_cs: customer A (#7892) reports ~30% of requests 502. payloads small (~5KB), mostly streaming/chat. repro: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{...}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat` -> HTTP/2 502

jess_cs: sample ids: trace=tx-9b3f, req=8f7c

deploy-bot: deploy service-hosted-api v2.14.1 -> prod @ 2026-03-17T09:30:21Z (CI: green)

ben_eng: can someone paste the request/response headers (esp any billing/auth headers)? suspect auth proxy backpressure holding h2 streams open

alice_support: most affected are guest tenants but a couple paid accounts too. header we see: `X-BILLING-ACCOUNT: customer-xyz`

leo_infra: infra dashboard shows h2_streams_in_use spike in edge-east-1 to 6200 (pool soft limit 6000). `proxy_conn_pool_exhausted` counters incrementing concurrently

maria_sre: if pool is exhausted Envoy will return 502 for new streams waiting for a free connection. check metrics: `listener.<id>.upstream_rq_pending_overflow` and `http2.goaway_sent`

ben_eng: i'm running a quick load repro with auth latency simulated. can someone confirm auth p95?

maria_sre: auth p95 jumped to ~850ms at 09:36 for a short window. auth DB retries visible.

ben_eng: reproduced locally: 1000 concurrent h2 streams + auth lookup ~200ms => stable. increase auth latency to >500ms -> head-of-line blocking and immediate 502 spike. looks like auth backend throttle + connection pool limits = symptom

leo_infra: posting quick mitigation: bumping h2 connection pool by +20% in edge-east and enabling faster upstream request timeout (30s -> 4s aggressive for stalled auth lookups) while we investigate

maria_sre: implemented temp config in edge-east: set `upstream_rq_timeout_ms=4000`, increased h2_pool_size, added alert for `upstream_rq_pending_overflow > 0`. monitoring now

ben_eng: opening INF-4123 to track root cause and auth team follow-up. tagging auth infra: @maria_sre please coordinate

tim_product: customer impact is high; product aware and we're prioritizing SOC escalation :rotating_light:

jess_cs: customer reported retries with exponential backoff worked — success on 3rd try. will relay mitigation suggestions (client-side backoff + keepalive tuning)

leo_infra: after temp change, error rate in edge-east dropped to baseline within ~7m. still observing slightly elevated auth latency but no sustained 502 spike

ben_eng: next steps: (1) auth infra to investigate DB throttling / cache warmers, (2) make h2 connection pool autoscale more aggressively when pending overflow detected, (3) consider failing fast on auth to let clients retry instead of holding streams

alice_support: communicating status to open tickets: "we're seeing transient auth backend latency causing connection pool pressure at the edge; we applied a temporary config change that reduced 502s. engineering is investigating a permanent fix."

maria_sre: will file full postmortem if rollback or customer impact continues. drop traces/logs into INF-4123. :thumbsup:

jess_cs: customers updated: reduced 502s after ~12:00 UTC, folks are unblocked. will close tickets after confirmation

ben_eng: adding a small reproducible script to INF-4123 (local h2 client + auth-delay) for auth team to run

alice_support: thanks all — keep updates here. if anyone finds correlated LB/NGINX anomalies post-deploy call it out and we escalate to eng-sre/incidents
